text:
GPT image Prompt:
Vertical 3:4, luxury fashion editorial photography, ancient Chinese noblewoman at elegant tea table, sophisticated Ming-dynasty chic, vintage couture aesthetic, cinematic realism.

【Subject】Poised ancient Chinese woman wearing black-and-white brocade cross-collar jacket (织锦对襟袄) with structured shoulders, crisp white silk blouse (白色丝绸中衣), layered pearl necklaces (珍珠璎珞), gold hairpins with dangling pearls (金步摇), bold vermillion lips (朱唇). Short elegant updo with loose strands framing face, intense confident gaze directed straight toward camera.

【Setting】Elegant upscale Chinese tea chamber (雅室茶轩) with ornate rosewood chairs (红木椅), polished dark lacquer table (漆黑漆案), delicate white porcelain teacup (白瓷茶盏), embroidered silk fan (绣花团扇), and lacquerware cosmetic box (漆器妆奁) in foreground.

【Costume Details】Tailored black-and-white brocade cross-collar jacket with structured shoulders, decorative gold knot buttons (盘扣), delicate white silk trim. Crisp white silk blouse with mandarin collar. Layered luxurious pearl necklaces around neck. Understated gold drop earrings with jade pendants (金玉耳坠).

【Pose】Seated upright at tea table with relaxed shoulders, conveying effortless elegance and quiet authority. Hands gracefully positioned near teacup. Confident posture, refined makeup with vermillion lips and subtle eye definition.

【Lighting】Soft natural window light from left, warm golden reflections on silk and pearls, gentle shadows, muted highlights, refined cinematic atmosphere. Timeless editorial sophistication.

【Rendering】Shallow depth of field, realistic brocade and pearl textures, warm neutral tones with vermillion accents. Softly blurred upscale interior background. High-end fashion photography quality.

Negative: text, watermark, distorted hands, extra fingers, malformed jewelry, warped objects, incorrect patterns, duplicated objects, plastic skin, excessive retouching, oversaturated colors, cartoon effects, blurry subject, cluttered composition, modern elements, Western clothing, anime style.

Signature: "AI art gallery | @sandmrk" small white Arial bottom center.
